cards.title: Optimize subscription billing reminder emails
cards.claim: For one subscription brand, changing a billing reminder to include education, benefits, free gifts/perks, a delay-order path, and moving manage-subscription to the bottom was reported to decrease cancellations from 8.6% to 5.8% (stated as 33% decrease and 28%).
cards.action: Take billing reminders off the subscription platform (e.g., Recharge/SKO) and build them into Klaviyo; include education and benefits, highlight free gifts/perks, push delay-order one-click links, and place the manage-subscription button at the bottom; customize reminders by product and rebill/order number; communicate gifts and avoid giving more of the same product as a free gift.

Legally required or standard billing reminder is being sent
Platform integration allows moving/building the reminder in Klaviyo
Customer has a planned free gift or perk
do_not_use_when: Legal requirements require specific billing reminder content or timing
Giving more of the same product as a free gift would create excess product
unknowns: Whether the 8.6% to 5.8% result generalizes beyond the single brand/test

Reason for 33% vs 28% discrepancy in the passage

cards.title: Optimize order confirmation emails in subscription flows
cards.claim: Order confirmation emails can be a major churn point: for one 8-figure subscription brand, the biggest churn spike was day 30, the first rebill/Shopify confirmation email, and it was described as literally double the billing reminder email.
cards.action: Make the order confirmation less scary by adding dynamic order content, product benefits, and testimonials; customize it by subscription vs one-time order and order number; where eligible, reach out to Shopify support to turn off the order notification email and build it into Klaviyo.
applies_when: Subscription brand using Shopify order confirmation emails
Brand can modify or route order confirmation messaging
do_not_use_when: If platform/Shopify Plus rules prevent turning off or modifying the order notification email; verify the passage's conflicting Shopify Plus statements
If legal/transactional requirements require the original Shopify confirmation
unknowns: Shopify Plus eligibility is contradictory in the passage
Exact implementation steps and compliance constraints

It is literally doubled the billing reminder email which literally says we're about to charge you.
if you are not on Shopify Plus, you can reach out to the Shopify support team
we want to customize it again based on if it's a subscription versus if it's a onetime order.

cards.title: Limit campaign sends to active subscribers
cards.claim: Over-sending campaigns to active subscribers was associated with many cancellations; every email sent was described as a reminder or prompt for subscribers to reconsider their subscription.
cards.action: Communicate with subscribers only through billing reminders, order confirmations/other notifications, and minimal and mindful campaigns; avoid over-sending active subscribers.
do_not_use_when: Non-buyer communications may follow different rules (not fully specified)
unknowns: Exact send-frequency threshold that counts as over-sending
Whether the cancellation pattern generalizes beyond the described 8-figure brand
evidence_quotes: We should only be communicating with our subscribers in three ways. the billing reminders, order confirmations, and other notifications, and then minimal and mindful campaigns.
You just get so many cancellations if you over send your active subscribers.
Every email you send is a reminder or prompt for somebody to reconsider if they want to be subscribed to your product.
